findings.claim: Retail 004AD6F0 executes through top-level VCF construction for GTSi and bus with original VDF/WDF/CDF callback chains, producing 46/44 world objects, 31/29 verified body parts and four verified class-30 weapon nodes per vehicle.
findings.limitations: Original x86 instructions in Ghidra emulator; OS/CRT/file services, palette and renderer substituted. Reports construction, not real Windows gameplay.

findings.claim: All 46 requested VTF-to-TMT registrations (24 GTSi, 22 bus) execute original 00449680, invoking native 0044AB90 TMT frame decoder and 0044AC80 owner binding, with verified object owner pointers, per-object logical keys, TMT records and first retail frame names.
findings.limitations: MAP/M16/VQM pixel decoding, timed texture animation and teardown reference release remain untested. Original TMT bytes supplied by emulated resource service.

findings.claim: In the same top-level vehicle sessions the original 004469A0 geometry cache and 00446C90 constructor produce eight non-null runtime GEO payloads from seven byte-verified retail resource identities, including each vehicle's auxiliary and exterior/cockpit body resources and the shared headlight-mask GEO.
findings.limitations: Indexed PIX/PAK resource-provider implementation is substituted here; full resource pipeline was independently emulated in historical v1.4–v1.7. Palette helper remains stubbed.

findings.claim: After native VCF construction the original 004466C0 selector changes one body node from group 0 to group 4 and back; original geometry cache constructs each resource once and reuses exactly the first exterior pointer on return for both GTSi and bus while the node class/parent/orientation/position remain unchanged.
findings.limitations: Geometry-change texture refresh 0044A0B0 is substituted. Selection observed for root body part only and one group transition per vehicle; not all original animation/render states.

findings.claim: Native TMT records and geometry handles are not yet traced through MAP/M16/VQM pixel materialization, real texture refresh or the primary polygon rendering pass; material registration should not be equated with verified rendered surface assignment.
findings.limitations: Next experiment must bridge 0044A0B0 to actual render-preparation routines with retail texture data.
